test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 24 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.**

In order to support countries with a concerted approach for an inclusive, and government-led assessment of post-disaster damages, losses, and recovery needs, as well as the development of a **__comprehensive__** recovery plan, the European Commission, the World Bank, and the United Nations adopted the Post Disaster Needs Assessment (PDNA) process in 2008.
solution:
The correct answer is "complete."**
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"comprehensive"** means complete and including everything that is necessary. (पूर्ण और इसमें वह सब कुछ शामिल है जो आवश्यक है)

 
 
• Example: *We offer you a **comprehensive**__ training in all aspects of the business.*
 
 
 
• The synonym of "comprehensive" is "complete."
 
• The word "complete" means having or including all parts; with nothing missing. (संपूर्ण; सर्वांशपूर्ण, सारा)
 __
 
• Example: *I gave a **complete**__ list of the stolen items to the police.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, the​ correct answer is Option 3.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• Sustainable: **involving the use of natural products and energy in a way that does not harm the environment. (पर्यावरण को हानि पहुँचाए बिना प्राकृतिक पदार्थों और ऊर्जा का उपयोग करते हुए)
 
• **Clear: **easy to see, hear or understand. (देखने, सुनने या समझने में स्‍पष्‍ट, साफ़)
 
• **Restricted: **controlled or limited. (नियंत्रित या सीमित)
